name: frame_broll
description: Frame a landscape clip on a vertical timeline (b-roll) in one call, never a blind centre crop: track follows its moving subject with a keyframed crop; card insets the whole frame on paper with corner brackets and a 'Footage: <source>' credit, above the captions; auto (default) cards landscape action across the frame (its whole width, zoomed to the subject, burned-in text left out where it can) and tracks only a subject a 9:16 crop holds with room to move, clear of the captions; when the profile's titles and overlays notes ask for mattes for wide footage, auto cards it on that matte (its colour, small centred credit). A human edit since the read is refused. Answers with a sheet of the clip's range.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {id, mode (track, card or none), why (what it chose and why; the clip is done), keys? (crop keys), found? (frames with the subject), card? (the overlay's id), path (the sheet)}; for a list, {items: [one each, or {id, error, message}], path}. detail adds the crop width and the card's box.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: item
params.description: Its b-roll item id on an upper track (add it first); a list frames all in one call. id=track or id=card sets its mode; in a split, id=track@top, @bottom or @x,y,w,h fills that slot, id=region@x,y,w,h[@slot] holds a region.

params.name: mode
params.description: auto: card action across the frame, track what a 9:16 crop holds. track: a crop following the subject. card: the frame inset.
params.hint: to read an item's framing, get_project tracks

params.name: source
params.description: Where the footage is from, for the card's credit: 'PhoneBot project video' gives 'Footage: PhoneBot project video'. Left out, the credit comes from the source's title, site or downloaded file name.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the crop width and the card's box.
